item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a wind-down built in: a relaxation session in the evening, then a set bedtime at 22:15. Protect that sequence. Sleep is where the rest of your day gets consolidated, so cutting it short costs you tomorrow's focus and patience. Keep the screens dim after your evening check-in, and keep the room cool and quiet. Your action: set a phone alarm for 21:45 as your lights-down signal.
